result.quote: Since he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain, he built towers in the desert and dug many cisterns.
result.reason: The stated reason for building the desert towers was that Uzziah had much livestock. His being “a lover of the soil” instead explains why he employed farmers and vinedressers. The question should specify the desert towers, since the window also mentions fortified towers in Jerusalem, and it calls them “towers,” not explicitly “watch towers.”
